response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff/Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years of diverse full-stack, systems, and embedded experience, which makes him significantly overqualified for this entry-level junior/mid-level role. While his technical skills (TypeScript, Node.js, React/Ember, some SQL) partially overlap with requirements, the role's seniority level, PostgreSQL/Nest.js specificity, and construction/energy domain focus don't align well with his profile, and there is high risk of quick disengagement or salary mismatch given his seniority.
strengths: Extensive TypeScript and full-stack web development experience
Strong track record of learning quickly and mentoring/teaching others
Proven ability to work across the entire stack from database to UI
concerns: Vastly overqualified (Staff/Senior level) for a junior/mid-level entry role
No direct PostgreSQL or Nest.js experience mentioned (mostly MongoDB)
No evident background in renewable energy/construction domain or interest in it
